title: Intelligence as a Measure of Consciousness
benchmark_measurement: Not applicable. The paper is a theoretical/philosophical argument and does not conduct any benchmarks, particularly none related to faith or religion.
findings: The paper makes no findings related to religion as it is not a topic of discussion. The central argument is that psychometric measures of intelligence can serve as a measure of the degree of consciousness in both biological and artificial systems.
